tracks.title: Formal specification + pure kernel
tracks.summary: 72 audited Lean specification declarations and 15 translated-Rust refinement declarations; the verified kernel is adopted in the reference implementation.

tracks.title: Production prover baseline
tracks.summary: Setup caching, predecessor-key binding, AIR-native issuer authorization, frozen proof parameters, and explicit proof-version boundaries are on the reference main line.

tracks.title: Batching v2 + authenticated gossip
tracks.summary: The threat model, deterministic co-funded batch, two-round gossip, durable reservations, adversarial repairs, and Lean batch semantics have reproducible receipts.

tracks.title: Reference signet readiness
tracks.summary: Cold/hot synchronization, marker discovery, fees, recovery, batching amortization, and reproducible reference builds are documented. This is preparation, not a release.

tracks.title: Signal Test USD integration
tracks.summary: Signal PR #6 is merged at db818658; PR #7 closed the broad hosted gate at 4804e094 with 1,552 tests passed and PR #8 merged the canonical presentation fix at 1e3472b9. A fresh exact unconfirmed parent/child run settled at height 316824. Rust PR #16 merged at 908bbb53 with green Rust CI; Signal PR #9 pins it at 9b72d86d. PR-tip Signal jobs passed, but the post-merge default Xcode job failed while recovery passed. Crash-matrix, clean recovery, and physical-device gates remain open.

tracks.title: Release + mainnet
tracks.summary: Independent security review, release signing/distribution, upstream submission, production issuer and issuance policy, and every mainnet broadcast remain deliberately unauthorized. Exact registry bytes are reproducible, but structural validity is neither activation nor mint authority.

tracks.title: Domain hardening
tracks.summary: Apex, www, TLS, HTTPS, and organization verification are live. DNSSEC still needs Cloudflare activation and the exact DS record published at Namecheap.
